name: Himalayan Bistro Oceanside
notes: 3 photos: indoor lunch-special board and outdoor A-frame sign show the same Daily Lunch Special list (merged, not duplicated) despite listing different prices ($15.99 vs $14.95) for the special itself; third photo is the main printed menu page (Tandoori, Biryani, Himalayan/Nepalese specials, sides, desserts). Wine/beer/non-alcoholic beverage listings on the main menu page were skipped as drink-only.
